grammar.summary: 本课讲述海关检查经历，运用 even if 让步状语从句、make sb do（使役结构）的被动式 be made to do，以及 should have done 表示「本应该做而没做」的责备；同时出现分词短语作状语与 which 引导的定语从句。

points.title: even if 让步状语从句 (Concession with even if)
points.explanation: even if 引导让步状语从句，意为「即使」，表示退一步的假设或事实。本课用 even if he has five hundred gold watches hidden in his suitcase 说明「即使手提箱里藏着500只金表，老练走私犯也处之泰然」。

examples.en: The hardened professional smuggler, on the other hand, is never troubled by such feelings, even if he has five hundred gold watches hidden in his suitcase.
examples.cn: 而老练的职业走私犯却使手提箱里藏着500只金表，却也处之泰然。

points.title: 使役结构被动式 be made to do (Passive causative)
points.explanation: 主动 make sb do sth 在被动句中变为 be made to do sth，需补回 to。本课用 are often made to feel guilty 说明「诚实的人常被弄得觉得有罪似的」，主语是 make 的承受者，故用被动并补 to。

examples.en: Even really honest people are often made to feel guilty.
examples.cn: 甚至是最诚实的人也常弄得觉得有罪似的。

points.title: should have done 责备 (should have done)
points.explanation: should have + 过去分词，表示「本应该做某事（而实际没做）」，含责备或遗憾意味。本课海关官员用 You should have declared that 责备叙述人「刚才本该申报香水」。

examples.en: 'You should have declared that. Perfume is not exempt from import duty.'
examples.cn: “你刚才应该申报，香水要上进口税的。”

exercises.q: The hardened professional smuggler...is never troubled by such feelings, ______ he has five hundred gold watches hidden in his suitcase.
Even really honest people are often ______ to feel guilty.
'You ______ have declared that. Perfume is not exempt from import duty.' 海关官员的话表示______。
用 should have done 填空（写出助动词部分，两个词）：'You ______ ______ (declare) that.'
下列哪个词与课文中 officious 的含义最接近？
